name: ROOT
Description: Starting the interview

name: MDDROOT
Description: ICEBREAKING. Check for depressed mood

name: SUB
Description: Determine if the patient's depressed mood is primarily due to the physiological effects of a substance, such as drugs, alcohol, or medications for any medical conditions.

name: SUB_SEV
Description: Evaluate if the depressive symptoms reported by the patient are the primary focus of the clinical picture and are of sufficient severity to require clinical attention.

name: SIDD
Description: substance/medication-induced depressive disorder

name: SI
Description: substance intoxication; substance withdrawal;other adverse effect of medication

name: MED
Description: Determine if the patient's depressed mood is primarily caused by the physiological effects of a general medical condition, such as physical health issues.

name: MED_COG
Description: Assess whether the patient shows evidence of decline in one or more cognitive domains, including complex attention, executive function, learning and memory, language, perceptual-motor abilities, or social cognition.

name: MNEUD
Description: major or mild neurocognitive disorder due to another medical condition, with behavioral disturbance

name: MEDDD
Description: Depressive disorder due to another medical condition

name: MANIC
Description: the patient has reported clinicallly significant manic or hypomanic symptoms

name: MANIC_DUR
Description: criteria met for a manic episode (i.e., **at least 1 week of elevated**, expansive or irritable mood accompanied by increased activity or energy and other characteristic symptoms sufficiently severe to cause marked impairment).

name: MANIC_DUR_HALL
Description: The patient meets the criteria if they acknowledge having a history of delusions or hallucinations.

name: MANIC_DUR_HALL_PSYC
Description: The criteria are met if the patient's psychotic symptoms occur exclusively during manic or major depressive episodes.

name: BPIPSYC
Description: Bipolar I disorder with psychotic features

name: SCHIZ
Description: Schizophrenia spectrum or other psychotic disorder

name: BPI
Description: Bipolar I disorder

name: MANIC_DUR_HYPO
Description: Criteria met for a hypomanic episode (i.e., at least 4 days of elevated, expansive, or irritable mood accompanied by increased activity or energy and other characteristic symptoms not severe enough to cause marked impairment) and has at other times met criteria for a Major Depression Episode.

name: MANIC_DUR_HYPO_HALL
Description: The patient meets the criteria if they acknowledge having a history of delusions or hallucinations.

name: MANIC_DUR_HYPO_HALL_PSYC
Description: The criteria are met if the patient's psychotic symptoms occur exclusively during manic or major depressive episodes.

name: BPIIPSYC
Description: Bipolar II disorder with psychotic features

name: SCHIZ2
Description: Schizophrenia spectrum or other psychotic disorder

name: BPII
Description: Bipolar II disorder

name: MANIC_DUR_HYPO_DUR
Description: The criteria are met if the patient explicitly reported at least 2 years of hypomanic symptoms along with periods of depressed mood. Duration should be explicitly asked.

name: CYC
Description: Cyclothymic

name: OTHBP
Description: Other specified bipolar and related disorders or unspecified bipolar and related disorders

name: DEPEPS
Description: The criteria are met if the patient has experienced one or more major depressive episodes without any history of manic or hypomanic episodes.

name: DEPEPS_HALL
Description: The criteria are met if the patient acknowledges having a history of delusions or hallucinations.

name: DEPEPS_HALL_PSYC
Description: The criteria are met if the patient's psychotic symptoms occur exclusively during manic or major depressive episodes.

name: DEPEPS_HALL_PSYC_DUR
Description: The criteria are met if the patient explicitly reported a duration of the depressive episode lasting 2 years or longer.

name: MDDPDDPSYC
Description: Major depressive disorder with psychotic features, plus persistent depressive disorder

name: MDDPSYC
Description: Major depressive disorder with psychotic features

name: SCHIZ3
Description: Schizophrenia spectrum or other psychotic disorder

name: DEPEPS_HALL_DUR
Description: The criteria are met if the patient explicitly reported a duration of the depressive episode lasting 2 years or longer.

name: MDDPDD
Description: Major depressive disorder plus persistent depressive disorder

name: MDD
Description: Major depressive disorder

name: DUR
Description: The criteria are met if the patient explicitly reported experiencing a depressed mood more days than not for at least 2 years, accompanied by associated symptoms. The duration should be explicitly asked

name: PDD
Description: persistent depressive disorder

name: DEPFW
Description: The criteria are met if the patient experiences a depressed mood that is regularly present in the final week before the onset of menses and becomes absent in the week after menses. This mood disturbance must be associated with clinically significant distress or interference with work, school, usual social activities, or relationships with others.

name: PDYSD
Description: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder

name: DEPCOM
Description: The criteria are met if the patient's depressed or dysphoric mood is an associated feature of another mental disorder (e.g., "demoralization" related to having Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder).

name: DEPCOM_DIST
Description: The criteria are met if the mood disturbance is clinically significant, meaning it causes substantial distress or impairment in the patient�s daily functioning.

name: OTHDD
Description: Other specified depressive disorder; unspecified depressive disorder

name: NOTDD
Description: No mood disorder diagnosis needed

name: OTH
Description: The criteria are met if the patient exhibits clinically significant depressive symptoms not covered by other criteria, which represent a psychological or biological dysfunction in the individual.

name: OTH_MALA
Description: The criteria are met if the patient exhibits a maladaptive response to a psychosocial stressor, meaning their response is disproportionate or ineffective, leading to significant distress or impairment in functioning.

name: ADJD
Description: Adjustment disorder with depressed mood

name: OTHDD2
Description: Other specified depressive disorder; unspecified depressive disorder

name: NORMALBLUE
Description: "Normal" everyday blues

name: NORMAL
Description: No mental disease symptoms; everything is normal
